name: Design drawing upload success-flow hotfix
scope: Stop drawing uploads from falling through to the generic JSON management API
Preserve the successful HTTP 201 result and allow the dashboard to refresh

dataIsolation.guard: The hotfix changes only browser control flow after the tenant-scoped binary upload endpoint returns. It does not change Drive or Notion targets.

changes: Guard the generic management API call so it runs only for non-drawing forms
Add a regression assertion for the post-upload control-flow guard
definitionOfDone: Drawing dry run and package validation pass
A successful drawing upload no longer shows the undefined.includes false failure
The project refreshes and displays the stored version
No existing Drive file or Notion version row is changed
